items.back: Sunday decree. Mechanism: an authority closes the exit by rule on a whole class, and the one condition of doing it is that nobody is told, since the telling would be the cue to leave; so it lands in the hours the holder is locked out anyway. Greek banks did not open on Monday 29 June 2015 after a Sunday speech. Cyprus declared a bank holiday in March 2013 and extended it when parliament voted down the first levy, until the bail-in was law. Argentina announced the corralito on a Saturday in December 2001. Export licences are suspended and listings removed, the notice published afterwards. What is lost is a permission: leave to move what is yours. Carrier: the authority's calendar, arranged to coincide with Friday night and the bank holiday. Threshold: the decree itself; it must strike before it can be known, so no date exists to wait for and the mechanism issues no notice. Tell: a weekend, a holiday, a Sunday speech, deposits leaving on rumour at the discount the rumour market charges. Changed next move: the transfer made on the rumour, paying that discount and the cost of being wrong; the deposits that left Greece that spring left on nothing firmer. Fence: not a lapse the holder can test by letting it pass, and not a withdrawn offer or a rival's foreclosure decided at the holder's own table; a decree rules on a class and consults no one. The decree names the exit; it is not a side effect. Supplies runway-illusions' Cash behind glass the reason it was a Friday.

Bar date in the newspaper. Mechanism: the claim expires on a date fixed in a proceeding the holder does not attend, on the legal theory that the holder read about it. The bankruptcy court sets a bar date for proofs of claim and notifies the creditors it cannot name by a newspaper notice. The class settlement's opt-out date arrives on a postcard that looks like advertising. The probate creditor's window opens when the notice runs in the county paper and closes some weeks later. What is lost is a permission: standing to be paid, or to sue on one's own. Carrier: the bar-date order plus constructive notice, under which publication counts as knowledge for anyone the debtor could not name. Threshold: the date on the docket, credited to the holder whether or not the holder ever saw it. Tell: a legal notice in small print, a postcard from a settlement administrator, a county-paper run; the holder is missing from the room while the record stays complete. Changed next move: the one-page proof of claim or the signed opt-out, the cheapest filing in the law and the one least often made, because the person who would make it is by construction the person who was not told. Supplies runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, where the date is printed on the stamp, the date written on someone else's docket. Not deal-deaths' Missing witness: nothing is missing from the record.

Parent paper. Mechanism: the option was issued under a parent instrument with a term of its own, so it ends when the parent ends, on its merits or not, and the option carries no date; the date sits on a different piece of paper. The emergency-use authorization ends when the declaration it was issued under is terminated, a different paper from the public-health emergency, which ended in May 2023 while the authorizations stayed up, surprising people who assumed one paper. Cross-state telehealth licences lapsed with each state's emergency in 2021 and 2022, state by state. The wartime power, the pilot under a waiver, the sub-lease ending with the head lease: the same. What is lost is a permission. Carrier: the parent's date, which the holder never signed and may never have read. Threshold: the parent's termination, whichever paper carries it; step one is finding out which. Tell: a grant with no date on its face, an emergency that looks permanent, a waiver nobody has re-read. Changed next move: conversion, a full approval, a permanent rule, a licence in the holder's own name, filed while the parent still stands; conversion is slow enough that it must begin while the emergency looks endless, which is exactly when nobody begins it. Not Bar date in the newspaper, where the date is imputed; here the date is honest, just on another paper. Not lead-time-floors' Calendar with nothing in it, a wait the rule imposes; this rule imposes no wait. It ends.

Patch before seven. Mechanism: the option expires on the holder's own developmental schedule, which the holder cannot read, so the last intervention sits by arrangement in somebody else's hand. Amblyopia is most correctable by patching the good eye in the first years; after about seven the response drops, though the trials of the 2000s found response into the early teens, so seven is approximate and the eye has not read the trials. The clubfoot is cast in infancy. The second language is accentless if learned early, a disputed window. The duckling imprints on its first day on whatever is there. What is lost is a capability: the cortex's willingness to rewire. Carrier: the developmental timetable, running in a child who has not been told there is an eye to save. Threshold: roughly age seven for the eye, with a long soft tail; earlier for the foot. Tell: a squint, a preschool vision check failed or never given; where there is no screening programme, the option expires unseen at a rate that belongs to the programme, not the child, and the programme is not audited for it. Changed next move: the screening, the preschool check, the parent who notices; the option belongs to one person and its preservation to another, and that is the arrangement. Supplies Last known well the case where the holder cannot be its own witness at all. Not a use-it-or-lose-it: nothing the child does runs the clock. The child is not involved.

Last known well. Mechanism: the option is dated by the last person who saw the fact, not by the fact, so it expires when the proof runs out; the body is available for comment and not consulted. The stroke patient wakes with the deficit and is ineligible for thrombolysis, because the four-and-a-half-hour window counts from last seen well, which was bedtime; the artery may have closed at six, but nobody was there at six, so it closed at bedtime. The same rule dates the opened vial with no time on the label and the sample with a gap in its chain of custody: expired at the earliest moment they could have, since nobody can say they did not. What is lost is a capability: a treatment the protocol now declines to give. Carrier: the protocol's timestamp rule, which asks for a witness and does not ask the tissue. Threshold: the window counted from the last witnessed moment, not the true onset. Tell: a wake-up deficit, an unlabelled vial, a custody gap; the record's clock has run even where the body's may not have. Changed next move: a witness, someone awake, a time written on the vial; or a witness of another kind, imaging that reads the tissue's own clock, by which the WAKE-UP trial of 2018 gave the drug back to patients nobody had watched. Supplies witness-architectures the option that dies for lack of a trace while the fact would still permit it. Not Patch before seven, where the body's own clock has run.

Moot before the forum sits. Mechanism: the option to a decision expires because the situation finishes before the forum reaches it, so nobody declines, nobody rules, and the file closes as complete. DeFunis (1974) was dismissed as moot because the student was about to graduate from the law school whose admissions he had challenged, the court having taken long enough for him to finish the degree. The pregnancy ends before the appeal. The election is held before the ballot-access case. The tenant is evicted before housing court sits. The grievance is mooted by the reorganization that abolished the post. What is lost is a permission: the justiciability of the claim. Carrier: the ratio of the forum's pace to the harm's duration, a number nobody at the table sets and the forum does not publish. Threshold: the harm's natural end, whenever it falls relative to the docket; there is no date anywhere, which is part of the arrangement. Tell: a hearing date that lands after the harm's own calendar, a plaintiff whose status will change before judgment. Changed next move: a structure that outlasts the individual harm, the class certified before the named plaintiff's harm ends, which Sosna (1975) allowed, or the doctrine of harms capable of repetition yet evading review, which Roe rested on; the option is kept by a coordination or by a rule and never by hurrying, hurrying having been tried. Not deal-deaths' Cost of the last mile: nothing is eaten, the harm is simply over. Not Bar date in the newspaper.

Session ends. Mechanism: the body that could have said yes reaches the end of its own term with the matter pending, and its successor is never asked to say no; the matter is filed under things not decided. Bills die on adjournment sine die and are reintroduced from the beginning by the members still there. The treaty is signed and waits on a parliament that is dissolved. The permit application waits on a council that is re-elected. The old board agreed the approval in the hallway and had not minuted it when the board was reconstituted, so it was agreed by a body that no longer exists. The offer was approved by a committee the reorganization disbanded. What expires is the matter's place in the process; the successor starts at zero, that being where successors start. What is lost is a counterparty: the specific body whose yes was available. Carrier: the ratifier's own calendar, election, session, or term. Threshold: adjournment, dissolution, the reconstituting meeting. Tell: a matter pending into the last weeks of a session, an approval that exists in conversation and not in minutes. Changed next move: the vote scheduled before adjournment, the carry-over motion, the approval minuted rather than agreed in the hallway. The treaty cases are simplified, most unratified treaties having eventually been refused by someone; the clean form is the legislative bill, which dies by the thousand each session with no recorded no, and this is regarded as normal. Supplies deal-deaths' Ratifier's other deal the ratifier that wanted this one and was gone before the vote. Not Landlord changes, where the counterparty is replaced by transfer; here by the calendar.

Landlord changes. Mechanism: an option held in a person rather than on the paper that transfers expires at the counterparty's next transfer, which the holder does not control and hears about afterwards. The landlord promises a renewal and sells to a buyer not bound by unrecorded promises and not told of this one. The manager says 'we'll take you back' and leaves. The side letter with a fund's partner is unknown to the successor manager, who has looked. The supplier's verbal priority departs with the account executive. What is lost is a counterparty: the one whose word held the option. Carrier: the register, the deed, the fund agreement, the offer letter on letterhead, on none of which the option was written, so the successor takes free of it. Threshold: the sale, the departure, the change of manager. Tell: a promise that lives in a conversation with a named person, and a for-sale sign, a resignation, a fund transition. Changed next move: recording, a memorandum of option on the title, a side letter countersigned by the entity, the promise put on the paper that binds successors; this costs the awkwardness of asking a friendly counterparty to bind their unknown replacement, a real cost paid by almost nobody. Supplies term-sheet-powers' Successor in the chair its mirror: the replacement declines to honour a term the friend gave. Not Chair grown over, where the counterparty stays and the shape goes; here the counterparty goes.

Chair grown over. Mechanism: the option to return rests on a vacancy the counterparty has not yet re-planned, so it expires at the counterparty's next planning cycle, with no one declining the return and no one noticing a return was in question. The leave with no return date has its post split among three people at the next reorganization, each now doing a third of it and each surprised to give it back. The budget line is reallocated at year end. The supplier's line is retooled for the customer who stayed. The co-founder's empty seat is a seat by the next hire. What expires is the return to the seat; employment there afterwards is a new negotiation, from outside. What is lost is a capability on the counterparty's side: the shape that could receive the holder. Carrier: the counterparty's planning cadence, quarterly, annual, the next reorganization, which sets the expiry without reference to the holder, who is not on the agenda. Threshold: the cycle turning once. Tell: an open-ended leave, a resignation where a leave was meant, a reorganization announced. Changed next move: a dated return, a leave rather than a resignation, a reservation the cycle must respect, or the return itself before the cycle turns. Supplies traces-of-the-unlived's Vacancy tenant the case where nobody opposes the return; the absence is absorbed the way a building absorbs a closed door. Not forms-of-return's Reentry burn, a road open and hostile; this road closed and nobody closed it.

Signatures go stale. Mechanism: an option that needs many yeses at once expires unless the gathering outruns the decay of each yes, so a coordination has a half-life and is measured in it. Under Michigan's recall rule, signatures older than sixty days are invalid; under California's they must all fall within a hundred and sixty days, so the first signer's yes is going off while the last is collected and the circulator races the first page. The tender offer's minimum condition must be met by the offer's expiry. The crowd in the square goes home, individually, for reasons. The reunion becomes impossible one death at a time, on no date. What is lost is a coordination. Carrier: the validity window on each act of assent, written by the rule or by the assenter's own attention, whichever is shorter. Threshold: the moment the oldest yes lapses before the last one arrives. Tell: a petition with dated pages, a minimum condition tracked against an expiry, a turnout curve bending down before the count is reached. Changed next move: a gathering rate, paid circulators, a date agreed in advance, a pact that binds the early yeses until the last arrives. The recall and tender cases are observed; the crowd is analogy. Supplies who-can-be-bound's Place in line the coordination lost by other people's leaving. Not Session ends, where one body's calendar kills the matter; here many small calendars do, none large enough to blame.

Outgrown the buyer. Mechanism: the holder's own growth moves the counterparty out of reach, so the option to sell to the natural acquirer expires at the round that prices the company above what the acquirer can pay at all: a market capitalization smaller than the price, a wage cap, a fund's concentration limit, and past those a board's approval ceiling, with nobody at either table declining and both tables congratulating the holder. The preference stack now exceeds the largest deal any of the three strategic buyers has done. The player's wage has outgrown every club but two. The practice is too large for any partner to buy in and too small to list, and so the right size for nothing. What is lost is a counterparty: the buyer whose capacity was the option. Carrier: the acquirer's capacity, readable in its market value and deal history, set against the holder's own price, which each round raises to applause. Threshold: the last price under the ceiling, never identified as the last. Tell: a valuation crossing the acquirer's largest-ever deal, a wage crossing a cap, a size between two markets. Changed next move: the sale at the last price under the ceiling, or a round sized to stay under it, the one choice a founder is never advised to make, and does not. The item is analytical: every observed case can be read as a buyer that would have paid more, so it stands as a mechanism and not a count. Supplies market-deaths' Slowed past the rot the market the holder thins by growing. Not Chair grown over: the counterparty is unchanged and the holder has walked out of its range.

Pour the foundation. Mechanism: a permission is about to be withdrawn by a third party's rule change and can be kept only by an act in the world, no paper accepted in lieu. The building may proceed under the old zoning only if the developer substantially began, in reliance on a valid permit, before the ordinance passed; so the footings are poured the week of the council vote, and the concrete truck is, strictly, the filing. The nonconforming use survives the new code only if in use on the effective date. The grandfathered rate is kept only by the account that was open. What is lost is a permission. Carrier: the code and the vested-rights doctrine, which in most states vests on construction begun and in a few, as in Washington, on a complete application, so the last act differs by jurisdiction and the holder who knows which has a different week from the one who does not. Threshold: the ordinance's effective date, or the council vote. Tell: a rezoning on the agenda, a code revision in comment period, a permit in hand and no hole in the ground. Changed next move: the hole before the vote, an exercise begun rather than a filing made; the option is preserved only by starting to use it, and the hole is inspected. Supplies first-mover-forecloses, which holds the rival who changes the rules on purpose, the rule that changes for its own reasons with no rival attached. Not Slot flown empty, where the exercise must repeat; here one beginning vests for good, and the hole can stay a hole.

Slot flown empty. Mechanism: the permission expires by disuse and is kept only by exercise, so the clock runs while the holder does nothing and stops when the holder acts, and the act that keeps it is the exercise with its purpose removed. The airport slot must be flown eighty percent of the season or returned, so in early 2020 airlines flew empty aircraft between cities until the rule was waived, the aircraft arriving on time. The water right under prior appropriation is forfeited after five years without beneficial use, so fields are irrigated in a drought to keep the right. The trade mark is abandoned after three years' non-use. The mining claim is kept by annual labour. The department budget is spent in the last quarter so it is not cut. What is lost is a permission. Carrier: the regulator's usage ledger. Threshold: the eighty percent, the five years, the three years, the year's labour; the season starts at zero each time. Tell: a usage ratio drifting under the line, a right on the books with no hours against it. Changed next move: the empty flight, which costs the full price of using the option and returns nothing but the option, so that keeping and using are the same act and the upkeep is the exercise price, paid in fuel. Supplies runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, whose licence lapses without hours logged, the price at which it can be extended after all: hours flown for nobody. Supplies tollgates-that-must-buy's Stamp with an expiry the holder who must burn the permission to keep it, and power-trades' Leased strike the disuse that forfeits by rule. Not Pour the foundation, one act that vests; here no act ever finishes the keeping.

Thawed to be ready. Mechanism: preparing to exercise the option starts a decay the unprepared state did not have, so the option to wait expires because the option to act was made ready, which was the point. The vaccine vial keeps months frozen, weeks thawed, hours once punctured, each step toward the patient costing an order of magnitude of shelf. The epoxy's pot life begins at mixing. The drawn dose, the armed fuze, the reagent at room temperature, the opened surgical field, all counting. The reserve army cannot be held at the frontier through the harvest it was drawn from. What is lost is a capability: the good itself, spoiling in its ready state. Carrier: a chemistry or a season that begins at preparation and not before. Threshold: the shelf life of the ready state, hours to weeks. Tell: a tray thawed for whoever might come, a batch mixed for the whole day, doses discarded at closing. Changed next move: not preparing, or preparing in the smallest unit, the single-dose vial, the small mix, the tranche thawed for the day's bookings; the clinic that thaws a tray to be sure of serving everyone has bought its readiness with the doses it discards at closing. Mirror of Slot flown empty, where the option dies of not being touched; here it dies of being touched, and a holder of both must burn one and refrain from readying the other, and keep them straight. Not lead-time-floors' Understudy, a finished copy that does not spoil for having rehearsed. Not Kept on the machine, where the harm falls on the holder and is billed by the day; here it falls on the good, which is discarded.

First responsive pleading. Mechanism: the option must be taken before any other move on a linked matter, so its clock is the holder's own next act rather than a date; the holder who does nothing keeps it and the holder who does anything nearby loses it, the rule satisfied either way. The objection to personal jurisdiction is waived if left out of the first response, which has been filed. The patent is dead in Europe the morning of the conference talk and a year later in the United States, the talk having gone well. The appeal is waived by accepting the settlement. The election of remedies is made by electing one. The defect in the goods must be objected to before use, and the goods have been used. 'Speak now' is followed by the rest of the wedding. What is lost is a permission. Carrier: a rule that ties the option to a position in a sequence, the sequence written somewhere other than the option, in the rules of procedure, the patent statute, the sales code, so the holder learns the order from the loss. Threshold: the holder's own first act on the linked matter. Tell: a first filing being drafted, a talk scheduled, goods unpacked, a settlement about to be signed. Changed next move: the ordering itself, the provisional application filed the morning of the talk, the reservation written into the first filing, the objection lodged before the crates are opened, each costing nothing except knowing that an order exists, which is the expensive part. Not Slot flown empty, where inaction runs the clock; here inaction is the only thing that keeps it. Not Bar date in the newspaper; there is no date, and the holder alone strikes, and does.

First write. Mechanism: the option to reverse a move expires at the first act the new state performs that the old state cannot read, so the window is the pause between the change and its first consequence, and it closes with nobody deciding to close it; the new state has simply gone to work. The migration can be rolled back until the new service writes its first record in a shape the old schema rejects, which it does on the first request. The merger is reversible until the first combined payroll, on the usual day. The new address, until the first piece of mail. The reorganization, until the first hire into the new chart. The currency changeover, until the first contract in the new unit, which was the purpose of the changeover. What is lost is a capability: the old state's ability to take over from here. Carrier: the first write, performed in the ordinary course of business and not a decision about reversal at all. Threshold: the first record the old schema cannot read, the first payroll, the first letter. Tell: a cutover with no dual-write period, a rollback plan whose deadline is the first customer request. Changed next move: the expand-and-contract shape, writing to both for a season so the old can still read, at the price of running two and of a season in which neither is the truth, which is tolerated. Supplies pivot-invariants the moment a retained asset is lost, and undo-costs the reversal that stops being possible and is therefore not billed. Not Thawed to be ready, where readiness spoils the good; here the good is fine and the new state's use closes the way back.

Kept on the machine. Mechanism: the option is held open by a device or an upkeep whose own running accumulates a harm, or whose lapse is one-way, so the deadline is the machine's and not the situation's. The patient on ECMO as a bridge to transplant becomes ineligible for the transplant the circuit was keeping her alive for, since bleeding, infection, and clotting rise with each week on circuit and centres set a duration past which candidacy is reviewed. The mothballed mine is kept dry by pumps whose stopping floods the workings past reopening, so the pumps run in a mine producing nothing, on a budget line. The reserve-fleet ship keeps her hull by cathodic protection a budget line can end. The interim chief has run the company past the point at which the search can bring in an outsider, the search having gone well. What is lost is a capability: the eligibility or the workings. Carrier: the bridge itself, its complication rate or its upkeep bill. Threshold: the centre's duration limit, the budget line's end, the interim's tenure crossing the point of no outsider; the ECMO limits are centre practice and simplified. Tell: weeks on circuit counted against a review, a pump line up for cuts, an interim whose search has quietly stopped. Changed next move: the listing at cannulation, the search begun the day the interim was named, the decision to stop pumping while a sale was still possible, each treating the bridge's start as the option's deadline, which it was. Supplies lead-time-floors' Bridge, a degraded replacement priced by the hour, the bridge that ends the option it holds open, on schedule. Not Standstill with a term, where the clock is a date the counterparty signs; here it is a harm nobody signs, keeping time anyway.

Standstill with a term. Mechanism: a pause taken to keep an option open is written on a paper with a date, so a situation that had no deadline now has one, and the paper's renewal belongs to the counterparty, who has been told by the paper what the pause is worth to the holder. The tolling agreement stops the limitations clock the holder could have stopped alone by filing, and expires in twelve months unless the adversary signs again. The negotiated leave dates a job that had no date and extends only if the employer signs. The forbearance holds the lender's foreclosure ninety days, the lender counting. The furlough's recall rights run six months. The takeover standstill keeps the bidder from buying shares and ends on the day it says. What is lost is a permission: leave to remain in the paused state. Carrier: the pause's own instrument, the only clock in the situation the holder wrote, and wrote voluntarily. Threshold: the paper's date, twelve months, ninety days, six months. Tell: a renewal that must be asked for, from the party across the table, who now knows what to charge. Changed next move: the renewal asked for before the counterparty learns it is needed, or a pause written without a term, rarely granted; the Korean armistice has no renewal date and is still called temporary. The statutory pauses, the family-leave statute's twelve weeks and the restraining order's fourteen days, are the same date without the mechanism, the renewal belonging to a court or to no one, so the holder gets the deadline without paying the counterparty; those are runway-illusions' Stamp's clock. Supplies impasse-inventions' cooling-off right the bill the chip carries. Not lead-time-floors' No-shop, which serializes the search; here the search is stopped, and the stopping is what expires.
